versions.content: Definition of configurable interface Com_RxIpduCallout Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02037 Service Name Com_RxIpduCallout Syntax boolean Com_RxIpduCallout ( PduIdType PduId, const PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x2A Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy don’t care PduId ID of the received I-PDU. Parameters (in) PduInfoPtr Contains the length (SduLength) of the received I-PDU and a pointer to the data of the I-PDU (SduDataPtr). Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value boolean true: I-PDU will be processed normal false: I-PDU will not be processed any further Description The I-PDU callout on receiver side can be configured to implement user-defined receive filtering mechanisms. Available via Configuration parameter ComUserCbkHeaderFile
